The '''Mission to Coruscant''' was a mission undertaken by [[Rianna Saren]] on behalf of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Background==
After escaping from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scout group on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Rianna Saren]] was contacted by [[Kyle Katarn]], who asked her to steal a shipment from a nearby [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun warehouse|warehouse]]. Rianna agreed after Katarn offered her a big reward.

==Mission==
Saren infiltrated the warehouse, evading [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and electrical barriers and killing many Black Sun mercenaries. But she was soon ambushed and captured. However, a shot from her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] accidentally activated an [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] [[Z-58-0]], who vowed to rescue a Twi'lek. He freed her and returned her blaster. Rianna allowed Z-58-0 to "tag along" and nicknamed him ''Zeeo''. Working together, they stole the shipment and escaped the warehouse only to be attacked by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. After successfully evading them, Rianna and Zeeo met with Katarn who introduced them to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Leia offered Rianna a chance to double her reward if she agreed to investigate strange activity on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where a Black Sun [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] commandeered a civilian vessel. Rianna and Zeeo soon departed for Alderaan.
